{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the garbage scow|the [[Garbage barge/Legends|garbage barge]]}}
{{Quote|The ''Falcon'' is the best ship in the galaxy.''"<br />"''That's your ship? I thought it was a garbage scow.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]]|<ref name="EA">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Eaten Alive]]''</ref>}}
A '''garbage scow''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed to traverse [[Realspace/Legends|space]], seeking out debris that was obstructing spacelanes.<ref name="Counterstrike">{{JournalCite|8|Counterstrike (Adventure Journal)}}</ref> During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy-conflict between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Fia (Jedi)|Fia]] had crewed a garbage scow on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], previous to being inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> During the administration of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[T-11|Tee-Eleven]] operated a garbage scow in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. However, over time, the droid's programming degraded and it vanished into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] together with its garbage scow, where it the scow was captured by the [[Restored Empire|Kaarenth Dissention]].<ref name="Counterstrike" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] crewed its garbage scows with hundreds of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Due to this, at least one of the Imperial garbage pontoons became a target of [[Saadoon-Kauldi]] during [[Saadoon-Kauldi's anti-slaver campaign|his anti-slaver campaign]], designed to release a big number of slaves. The [[rescue at the Imperial garbage scow]] released all the slaves in that ship, including a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] called [[Guzald]].<ref name="TBSoS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
